verdict.rationale: Metorial supports explicit tool-level allowlisting via `tool_filters` with type 'allow' and specific tool keys (metorial-docs-16, metorial-docs-7), plus server/provider-level control through attaching specific providers to a session and Workforce's 'approved integrations' governance (metorial-docs-33, metorial-docs-13). RBAC/SSO/IAM further ties agent access to existing security models (metorial-gh-1). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of tool_filters enforcement in production and more detail on deny-list or per-agent granularity beyond session-level filters.
